Whitespace inside <pre>, <textarea>, <script> and <style> blocks is preserved. Runs entirely in your browser.




  
  


  

    

      
📖 How to use

      
  1. Paste your HTML into the input box.
  2. Click Minify HTML.
  3. Check the original vs minified byte stats and the percentage saved.
  4. Copy the result or download it as an .html file.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
What does the minifier change?
It strips HTML comments (except conditional comments), collapses runs of whitespace, and removes whitespace between tags. The contents of <pre>, <textarea>, <script> and <style> blocks are preserved exactly.
Is whitespace inside pre and script tags preserved?
Yes — whitespace inside <pre>, <textarea>, <script> and <style> is left untouched so rendering and code behavior stay the same.
Is my HTML uploaded anywhere?
No. All minification happens locally in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
